scripts.build: npm run audit:extensions && tsc && vite build
scripts.build-and-install: tauri build && cp -R src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/BetterBar.app /Applications/ && xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/BetterBar.app || true
scripts.build-and-install:universal: tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin && cp -R src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/BetterBar.app /Applications/ && xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/BetterBar.app || true
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/appearance.test.cjs tests/bar-layout.test.cjs tests/presentation-and-search.test.cjs tests/settings-native.test.cjs tests/polling-and-docking.test.cjs tests/extension-drag.test.cjs tests/extension-install-review.test.cjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:typecheck && npm run build && playwright test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
